# DYM Sport

DYM Sport is a sports gear brand specializing in cycling and winter sports products. The brand uses a bold, energetic color palette of grey, black, bright green, and white, suggesting a modern, performance-driven identity. The business has an established logo, indicating a defined visual brand presence aimed at active outdoor sports enthusiasts.

Our Capabilities


## BUILT FOR DEMANDING TERRAIN


DYM Sport engineers outdoor gear for riders and alpine athletes who refuse to compromise. Every product is developed to meet the technical demands of cycling and winter sports — delivering durability, precision fit, and sport-specific confidence whether you're descending a mountain trail or carving a frozen slope.















### Cycling Performance


From road sprints to trail descents, DYM Sport cycling gear is engineered for aerodynamic efficiency, responsive handling, and endurance. Helmets, apparel, and accessories tested across competitive and recreational disciplines — part of what makes DYM a trusted name in academy sports and outdoor performance.


2X
IMPACT RESISTANCE VS. STANDARD SPEC














### Winter Protection


Ski jackets, insulated base layers, and snow sport accessories built to keep alpine athletes performing at altitude. DYM Sport winter gear combines thermal regulation, moisture management, and freedom of movement so cold conditions become an advantage, not a barrier.


-25°C
THERMAL RATED PERFORMANCE RANGE














### Technical Reliability


Every DYM Sport product passes rigorous material and construction testing before it reaches the athlete. From reinforced seam bonding to abrasion-resistant outer shells, our gear is designed to outlast the session and the season — dependable across every sport, every condition, every time.


500+
HOURS OF FIELD TESTING PER PRODUCT LINE































Two Disciplines. One Brand.



## BUILT FORMOTION &IMPACT


DYM Sport engineers gear for riders and alpine athletes who demand performance in every condition. From tarmac sprints to powder descents, our sports and outdoor collection is designed with precision, versatility, and the changing demands of terrain and weather in mind.










### Road & Trail Cycling


Aerodynamic helmets, performance apparel, and technical accessories for road sprinters and trail explorers. Gear built for speed, endurance, and all-weather confidence.

Explore Cycling











### Alpine & Winter Sports


Cold-weather protection, layering systems, and alpine-ready equipment for skiers and winter sport athletes. Designed to perform when temperatures drop and terrain gets demanding.

Our Story


# Built for Those WhoMove With Purpose


DYM Sport was born from a passion for outdoor performance — crafted for cyclists, alpine riders, and athletes who demand precision gear that keeps pace with their ambitions.





All Products

















Performance Driven


## From Road to Summit — We Gear You for Every Terrain


DYM Sport was founded on a single conviction: that serious athletes deserve gear engineered with the same precision they bring to their sport. We started with cycling — road, gravel, and mountain — and expanded into winter sports, building a curated range of technical apparel, protective equipment, and accessories that perform at altitude and at speed.


Every product in our lineup is selected for its performance credentials. We partner with leading manufacturers and test gear across real-world conditions — alpine descents, endurance rides, and everything in between. DYM Sport is not a warehouse of options. It is a focused, expert-led selection for people who live outdoors and move with purpose.


Whether you are clipping in for a dawn climb or strapping on your board for a first run, DYM Sport equips you with the confidence to push further. This is what academy sports and outdoor performance looks like when it is built around the athlete, not the shelf.



10+
Years of Expertise



2
Sport Disciplines



100%
Performance Tested




Discover Our Range














EST. DYM SPORT

























Our Philosophy


## Built on Four Pillars


Every product that carries the DYM Sport name is shaped by a set of uncompromising principles. From the first prototype to the final ride, these core values define how we design, test, and deliver gear for cyclists and alpine athletes who demand more from their equipment — and themselves.














### Performance


Every gram, every angle, every material choice is optimised for output. DYM Sport gear is engineered to reduce drag, absorb impact, and transfer energy efficiently — so you can push further, faster, with total confidence on the road or the mountain.












### Protection


Speed means nothing without safety. Our helmets, pads, and technical outerwear are developed to meet and exceed current safety standards, incorporating multi-density foam systems, reinforced shells, and weather-barrier technologies that keep you in control when conditions get extreme.












### Durability


Gear that fails mid-season is gear that was never truly tested. DYM Sport products are subjected to rigorous cycle and cold-weather stress testing before release. We use high-grade alloys, abrasion-resistant fabrics, and precision stitching to ensure your kit outlasts the harshest seasons.












### Design Clarity


Form follows function — and then refines it further. DYM Sport's aesthetic language is stripped of unnecessary complexity: clean silhouettes, purposeful colour blocking, and intuitive fit systems that allow athletes to focus on the ride, not the gear. Precision in design is precision in performance.






















Our Story


## Built for the Ride.Forged in the Alpine.




















01

### 2015


Brand Launch


DYM Sport was founded on a single conviction: performance gear should be built for athletes who push limits — not for the shelf. From day one, we set out to offer premium outdoor sports equipment with uncompromising technical standards and a bold identity.











02

### 2018


Cycling Specialization


Expanding our roots in academy sports and outdoor culture, DYM Sport doubled down on cycling — curating a focused range of road and trail gear engineered for speed, aerodynamics, and endurance. Every component chosen for performance, not fashion.











03

### NOW


Winter Sport Identity


Today DYM Sport stands as a dual-discipline performance brand — cycling and alpine. Our winter sport category brings the same precision-first philosophy to skis, boards, and cold-weather technical apparel, cementing our identity for riders and mountain athletes alike.




















Our Standards



## BUILT TO PERFORM. ENGINEERED TO LAST.


Every DYM Sport product is designed from the ground up for athletes who refuse to compromise. From high-alpine descents to technical trail rides, our gear is engineered to meet the demands of varied terrains and extreme weather conditions — delivering the precision and confidence you need when it matters most.










### Premium Material Selection


We source only certified high-performance fabrics and composites — from ripstop nylon shells to carbon-reinforced frames — ensuring every layer delivers durability, weight efficiency, and tactile quality.










### Technical Finish & Construction


Precision stitching, sealed seams, and reinforced stress points define every garment and product. Our construction standards are benchmarked against professional outdoor sports and academy sports and outdoors certification levels.










### Athlete-Minded Design


Developed with input from competitive cyclists and alpine athletes, every design decision — from pocket placement to ventilation zoning — reflects real-world performance needs across snow, gravel, and mountain terrain.


































Built for riders and alpine athletes who demand speed, precision, and technical confidence. Gear up. Go further.

Our Disciplines













Cycling

## Built for the Road.Ready for the Trail.




From high-speed road racing to technical mountain descents, DYM Sport cycling gear is engineered for riders who demand performance at every pedal stroke. Our range covers speed, control, and endurance across all terrain types — the kind of gear you'd find at any serious academy sports and outdoors destination.


- Speed & Aerodynamics Low-drag apparel and helmets optimised for maximum velocity on tarmac and gravel.

- Precision Control Gloves, pads, and footwear engineered for confident handling in any riding condition.

- All-Day Comfort Breathable, ergonomic fits designed to support long climbs and extended endurance rides.



Explore Cycling Gear



















Winter Sports

## Engineered for the Mountain.




When the mountain demands everything, DYM Sport winter gear delivers. Designed for skiers and snowboarders who push into extreme alpine conditions, our technical outerwear and protective equipment combine thermal performance with precision fit — trusted gear for serious academy sports and outdoor athletes.


- Advanced Insulation Multi-layer thermal systems that lock in warmth without restricting movement at altitude.

- High-Visibility Safety Reflective detailing and bold colourways for maximum visibility in low-light and storm conditions.

- Impact Protection Certified helmets, wrist guards, and back protectors built for aggressive descents and hard landings.



Explore Winter Gear

SUPPORT

## FREQUENTLY ASKEDQUESTIONS


Everything you need to know about reaching us and getting the right gear advice.








01


### How can I get in touch with the DYM Sport team?


You can reach us directly through the contact form on this page or by emailing our support team. Whether you have questions about cycling gear, winter sports equipment, or need help choosing the right product for your discipline, our team is ready to assist. We aim to respond to all enquiries within one business day.







02


### What is the typical response time for enquiries?


Our standard response window is within 24 to 48 hours on business days. During peak seasons — particularly ahead of winter sports and cycling race seasons — response times may extend slightly. For urgent technical questions, please indicate the nature of your enquiry in the subject line so we can prioritise accordingly.







03


### Which product categories does DYM Sport cover?


DYM Sport specialises in two core performance disciplines: cycling and winter sports. Our cycling range covers road, gravel, and mountain bike gear including helmets, apparel, and accessories. Our winter sports category includes ski and snowboard equipment, protective outerwear, and alpine accessories — all selected for technical performance and durability in demanding outdoor conditions.







04


### Can I get expert advice before making a product decision?


Absolutely. Our team includes active cyclists and alpine athletes who understand the demands of outdoor sports firsthand. If you need guidance on sizing, compatibility, or which product best suits your terrain and performance goals — similar to the expert advice you'd expect from top academy sports and outdoor specialists — use the contact form to describe your needs. We'll provide personalised recommendations based on your discipline and experience level.























Find Us

# Return Policy


Last Updated: 5/14/2026



At DYM Sport, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines your rights for returns and refunds.


## 1. Return Window


You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.


- Items must be unused and in original condition

- Items must be in original packaging

- Receipt or proof of purchase required




## 2. Non-Returnable Items


- Perishable goods

- Custom or personalized items

- Digital products and opened software

- Personal hygiene products that have been opened




## 3. Damaged or Defective Items


If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours for a full refund including shipping costs.


## 4. Contact Us



For returns or questions:


Email: [business_email]


Phone: [business_phone]


Address: [business_address]

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/14/2026



DYM Sport ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: DYM Sport

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 14, 2026



DYM Sport is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: DYM Sport

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

# Terms of Use



Last updated:  May 14, 2026



Use of this site constitutes agreement to the terms outlined below. Please read carefully before use.



## 1. Definitions


- "Company" - DYM Sport

- "User" - Anyone who browses or uses the site

- "Services" - Sports & Outdoor Retail provided through the site




## 2. Description of Services


DYM Sport provides Sports & Outdoor Retail through the site. The services are subject to the terms detailed in this document and may change from time to time.


## 3. Terms of Use


Use of the site is conditional on compliance with the following terms:


- Use of the site for lawful purposes only

- No interference with site operations or other users

- No uploading of offensive, illegal, or harmful content

- Respect for copyright and intellectual property rights

- No actions that may compromise site security




## 4. User Obligations


- Providing accurate and truthful information during registration or ordering

- Maintaining confidentiality of account access details

- Immediate notification of any unauthorized account use

- Updating personal information as needed




## 5. Payment and Refund Policy


If services include payment:


- Payments are processed through secure and encrypted systems

- Prices include applicable taxes as required by law

- Right to cancel will be in accordance with consumer protection laws

- Refunds will be processed within 14 business days of cancellation approval




## 6. Limitation of Liability


Services are provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. The Company will not be liable for indirect, consequential, or special damages arising from use of the site, except where required by law.


## 7. Copyright and Intellectual Property


All content on the site, including text, images, design, and code, is protected by copyright owned by DYM Sport. Reproduction, distribution, or commercial use of content is prohibited without written permission.


## 8. Privacy


Collection and use of personal information is subject to our Privacy Policy. Use of the site constitutes agreement to the Privacy Policy as detailed separately.


## 9. Changes to Terms of Use


The Company may change these terms of use at any time. Material changes will be posted on the site with 30 days advance notice. Continued use after changes constitutes agreement to the new terms.


## 10. Service Termination


The Company may suspend or limit service at any time, including in cases of terms of use violations. In case of service termination, relevant provisions will remain in effect.


## 11. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution


These terms of use are governed by applicable laws. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with local jurisdiction, with preference given to arbitration or mediation where possible.


## 12. General Provisions


- If any portion of the terms is found invalid, remaining terms will remain in effect

- Non-enforcement of a right will not be considered a waiver

- These terms of use constitute the entire agreement between the parties

For questions or clarifications regarding the terms of use:
